notes: amazon-koko-eating-bananas and citadel-square-root were in no pool; several rungs moved here from the binary-search pool. Real-number search is taught only by citadel-square-root (a pure bisection); no OA problem in the bank needs real-valued binary search on the answer cleanly (intuit-integer-house-heaters has a closed-form half-integer answer). amazon-package-delivery-system moved to heap (it is a max-heap simulation). amazon-minimize-variation, goldman-get-minimum-value and concentric-ai-maximum-profit-under-or-limit are not binary search on the answer.
